changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE catalog_item MODIFY order_index INT NULL; ALTER TABLE catalog_category MODIFY order_index INT NULL;
UPDATE catalog_item SET order_index = NULL WHERE is_deleted = 1; UPDATE catalog_category SET order_index = NULL WHERE is_deleted = 1;

changeSet.comment: Resolve any existing duplicates by setting one of them to NULL or shifting, for now just ensure uniqueness before constraint
changeSet.sql:
-- For catalog items: if two active items have the same order_index, reset the duplicates -- This is a simple fix to allow the migration to complete. -- Real sorting should be done by the user later. UPDATE catalog_item ci INNER JOIN ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY business_id, category_id, order_index ORDER BY id) as rn FROM catalog_item WHERE order_index IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0 ) t ON ci.id = t.id SET ci.order_index = NULL WHERE t.rn > 1;
-- For catalog categories: UPDATE catalog_category cc INNER JOIN ( SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY business_id, order_index ORDER BY id) as rn FROM catalog_category WHERE order_index IS NOT NULL AND is_deleted = 0 ) t ON cc.id = t.id SET cc.order_index = NULL WHERE t.rn > 1;
